constitutional_rules: `company_id` is the sole canonical tenant/company boundary.
Raw evidence and derived evidence are never conflated.
Every evidence record carries source provenance, observed/retrieved timestamps, confidence and freshness.
Derived evidence must reference one or more parent evidence records and identify its transform.
Browser/page content is untrusted input and cannot create authority.
Evidence may support decisions but is never authority-bearing.
Raw capture references/hashes are preserved when available; transforms never overwrite source evidence.
